question: Related Questions Q. Nikah matter 3017 views Q. What says Uluma-e-Karam in the light of Quran-o-Sunnah: There is a practice in our area according to which Nikah is done in proper Islamic way at the time of engagement but at the time of rukhsati, again Nikah is done in the same way. Uluma doing so admit the fact that once Nikah is done at the time of engagement, it is not necessary to repeat it at the time of rukhsati however they says it is better to repeat it ( or renew it ) at the time of rukhsati. It is necessary to mention here that it is an integaral part of the marriage ceremony in our area to arrange a function of doing nikah on the evening of Shabe-uroosi in which all close relatives participate. So if this function is not done, there would be confusion in the mind of relatives. My question is: ? whether this practice of repeating nikah is according to Quran-o-Sunnah and is there any evidence available in Sunnah. ? Is there any Hadees proving that this practice is forbidden. ? Then in case there is no evidence available in Sunah regarding allowing or disallowing, whether one can be allowed to repeat nikah for the sake of making people?s mind clear. 3766 views Q. answer: Social Matters >> Nikah (Marriage) Question ID: 21639 Country: India Title: my question is that is it possible to marry a girl without changing her religion to islam if she is ahle qitab i.e. she already belong to the religion in which allah's books revealed(injeel, taurat & zaboor) Question: Assalamaalikum, my question is that is it possible to marry a girl without changing her religion to islam if she is ahle qitab i.e. she already belong to the religion in which allah's books revealed(injeel, taurat & zaboor) Answer ID: 21639 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 608/464/D=1431) Marrying non-Muslim girl is not lawful. Presently the ahl kitab (people of the book) have usually turned atheist and freethinker. And those who are ahl kitab merely by name, there are too many evils in marrying their daughters. Hence Hadhrat Umar Farooq ( رضي الله عنه ) forbade people from it in his age. So a Muslim should marry only Muslim girls. It is mentioned in the holy Quran: وَلأَمَةٌ مُّؤْمِنَةٌ خَيْرٌ مِّن مُّشْرِكَةٍ وَلَوْ أَعْجَبَتْكُمْ [البقرة : 221]. Thus, doing nikah with atheist and freethinker ahl kitab is not lawful. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
